import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
X = np.random.randn(100, 3)
true_weights = np.array([2.5, -1.3, 0.7])
y = X @ true_weights + np.random.randn(100) * 0.5

X_bias = np.column_stack([np.ones(100), X])

w_normal = np.linalg.inv(X_bias.T @ X_bias) @ X_bias.T @ y

y_pred = X_bias @ w_normal

mse = np.mean((y - y_pred) ** 2)

ss_res = np.sum((y - y_pred) ** 2)
ss_tot = np.sum((y - np.mean(y)) ** 2)
r_squared = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot

X_centered = X - np.mean(X, axis=0)
cov_matrix = np.cov(X_centered, rowvar=False)
eigenvalues, eigenvectors = np.linalg.eig(cov_matrix)

sorted_idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
eigenvalues = eigenvalues[sorted_idx]
eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, sorted_idx]

X_pca = X_centered @ eigenvectors[:, :2]

total_variance = np.sum(eigenvalues)
variance_explained = eigenvalues / total_variance

print(f"True weights: {true_weights}")
print(f"Estimated weights: {w_normal}")
print(f"MSE: {mse:.4f}")
print(f"R-squared: {r_squared:.4f}")
print(f"Variance explained by each PC: {variance_explained}")
